notes.title: Defend from Candyland! 1.2!
notes.notes:
Greetings Defenders of Eden!

We are thrilled to announce the release of a major update for "Defend from Candyland!" bringing the game to version 1.2. This update includes a variety of new features, improvements, and enhancements to make your defense experience even more delightful and engaging.

[h1]What's New in Version 1.2?[/h1]
[h2]New Interactive Tutorial[/h2]

Learn from Dr. Dexter, one of the smartest trees, on how to best protect Candyland! Our new, interactive tutorial will guide you through all the essential mechanics and strategies, whether you're a new player or just need a refresher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/c31796733a38948744722f69a53dcb73ae26f222.gif[/img]

[h2]Story Added[/h2]

Immerse yourself in the sweet and adventurous story of Candyland. Discover the narrative behind the candy invasion as you help defend Eden from the unexpected attack. Engage with intriguing characters and uncover the mystery of why Candyland has turned sour. The fate of Eden lies in your hands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/0bd613508d0ca8c62c07eb522e8ed7b2ecba26cb.gif[/img]

[h2]New Layouts for a Better Experience[/h2]

We’ve revamped several key areas of the game to provide a smoother and more intuitive experience:

[h3]In-Game Menu[/h3]
- [b]New Design[/b]: The in-game menu has been completely redesigned for easier navigation and a more polished look.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/7815349fb755cb6bbddcc381cd13aee4ad1d1440.jpg[/img]

[h3]Main Menu[/h3]
- [b]Fresh Look[/b]: The main menu now features an updated layout to welcome you into the world of Candyland with style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/36e40ebf8f34efc16fd19fdd58cd7cf0b8ef28fe.jpg[/img]

[h3]Current and Next Enemy Boards[/h3]
- [b]Enhanced Layouts[/b]: We've updated the current and next enemy boards to give you clearer insights into the upcoming challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/f5a0d4a6e9c219951ba0528d0856962135d6dea1.png[/img]

[h3]New Shop Items[/h3]

Two new items have been added to the shop, providing strategic advantages:

- [b]Enemy Path Viewers[/b]: These items allow you to see enemy paths, helping you plan your defenses more effectively.

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]

- [b]Updated Art Assets[/b]: Enjoy a more vibrant and colorful Candyland with updated textures and graphics.
- [b]Repositioned Enemy Health Bars[/b]: We’ve repositioned enemy health bars for better visibility and tracking during intense battles.
- [b]Better notifcations[/b]: We've added a better notificaiton board, with text, to tell you when you can't place a tree and why, rather than the old colour system.

---

We hope you enjoy all the new features and improvements in version 1.2. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, so please let us know your thoughts on this update.

Thank you for defending Eden, from Candyland, with us!

Stay sweet,
Michael "MI Pixel" Ingram

notes.title: Exciting Steam Store Revamp for Defend from Candyland!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Candyland Defenders!

We're thrilled to announce a major transformation for Defend from Candyland! Our Steam Store page has just received a stunning artistic makeover, and we couldn't be more excited to share it with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/0cc61339290c3a12fdcf37e489ca18234300f2b8.png[/img]

The journey began when we collaborated with the immensely talented artist, Millie Elsdon-James. Her artistic prowess has breathed new life into our game's visuals, resulting in a visually captivating experience that we can't wait for you to see.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/1390d62da1e0d0a623f233e5f3fa32d086c6039d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/d6e438807f5b545eb4e783dcabd1bc56fd3c93f0.png[/img][/url]

Here's a sneak peek into the process:
[url=https://www.mipixel.co.uk/artistry-meets-gaming-defend-from-candyland-s-steam-store-makeover]Pixels and Play[/url]

Millie worked diligently, providing concept art that perfectly captured the essence of our game. We then had the tough choice of selecting the best design, which eventually led to a brilliant final concept. The attention to detail and creativity in the shading and coloring brought our vision to life in ways we could only dream of.

Plus, we have an exciting addition—a brand new logo for Defend from Candyland! This updated logo perfectly complements the game's new look, and we're thrilled with the results.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/acb9bf0426ff7b44cd80b42862616e2e929697ea.png[/img]

We invite you to dive into the world of Candyland and experience the game's artistic transformation firsthand. Your support and enthusiasm have driven us to continually improve, and we're committed to delivering the best possible gaming experience.

A huge thanks to Millie for her exceptional work, and we encourage you to explore her other creative endeavors. Check out her [url=https://linktr.ee/MillieElsdonJames]Linktree[/url] for a dose of artistic inspiration.

Get ready to embark on a visually stunning journey through Candyland—your adventure awaits!

Stay tuned for more exciting updates, and as always, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Birthday deal!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

So, it is my birthday this week and I thought, why not give something back? So, this week, there is 40% off of Defend from Candyland! making it £4.97, that's less than a fiver! 

Defend from Candyland! has 120 levels, a configurable endless mode, an endless version of all 120 levels, buffs, new towers, achievements and a public leaderboard for the Endless mode, can you make it to the top? 

This Tower Defence game is difficult, so difficult in fact that DeadGuard98 decided to try and help people out by making a little tutorial for you all to watch! Check it out here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rj7NOeGrCtA&t=5

Still unsure of whether to buy or not? Check out this great review from RetroFaith on FusionRGamer! [url=https://fusionrgamer.com/2023/03/15/defend-from-candyland-review/]FusionRGamer[/url]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
A small update to fix some small bugs. 

It would show the loadout menu if you hit restart on every level, even when it wasn't supposed to. This has now been corrected. 

A warning has now been added to the restart button. So, when you hit restart, it will not automatically reset the level, preventing you from losing your progress on the level by doing it on accident! 

Have fun player Eden's mightiest defenders! 

~ Michael "MI Pixel" Ingram

notes.title: Version 0.5.1
notes.notes:
Heya everyone, another major update is here!

[h2]Characters[/h2]

To start with, there is a new look coming to Defend from Candyland! There are a bunch of characters coming in and they will now show you around Eden and help you out. The new home screen now looks like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/ade102c1119e4f00d0ac8e05dfb822de7f3e6972.jpg[/img]

We have new characters, joining the old ones, to take you to different places. Along with this, we have created a Fandom.Wiki page here: [url=https://defend-from-candyland.fandom.com/]Defend from Candyland![/url] which currently has more details about the characters, more will be added to it soon!

Senorita Settings.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/27d7febb1d667193561ca3257b7644b989d7bf45.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/27d7febb1d667193561ca3257b7644b989d7bf45.gif[/img][/url]

Doctor Dexter.

[h2]Towers[/h2]

We have a new tower joining the fray and that is, the Cattail sniper!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/97dd40e6ed8ed3a1e22efc3da8c9160cb71335ba.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/97dd40e6ed8ed3a1e22efc3da8c9160cb71335ba.png[/img][/url]

This tower can hit all enemies, has a lot of power and has he largest range of any tower so far! This should certainly help against all enemies! 

The Anti-Air Carrot Field also has an upgrade, the upgrade from Miss Applebee's shop now increases their fire power by 5 instead of 1. Take down those Flying Saucers!

[h2]Endless Mode[/h2]

Endless Mode has had another update

The Endless Mode is now configurable, so, you can choose where you want the Spawning Jellies/Destination Trees to be! If however you leave it blank, Seargent Switch will randomly assign you between 1 & 3 of the Jellies/Trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/b730b5cd2413fb57ca506a5f6768bafd7caaa053.jpg[/img]

Speaking of Endless Mode, there is now an Endless Mode of each level in the game to unlock! You need to have gotten 3 Apples on the level, this will then allow you to compete in an Endless Version of that level for another high score and more apples! This change also brings a new look to the level select!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/05400727c1f1688d7ab31beebfc0fb93a7148e2d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Music[/h2]

Arman Mkhitarian has created another track for Defend from Candyland! to replace the current battle music. The old battle music is still in the game, however, it will only play when your health is in the red! 

[h2]Tips[/h2]

With the new characters, we now have Doctor Dexters Tips! If you pause the game, Doctor Dexter will pop up and give you a random tip about the game or its characters! 

[h2]Settings[/h2]

In the settings menu, the ability to manually save has now been added, along with, the ability to change your cursor! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/278885b21d7449b315958c8e10d04c4170ca3d85.jpg[/img]

So, with that, get out there and Defend from Candyland!

notes.title: Version 0.5.0!
notes.notes:
Greetings all, we have a new major update! 

This update is focused mainly around the "Endless Mode". There have been large improvements made to this. 

[h2]Endless Mode![/h2]

Endless mode has been changed to award Apples for certain achievements within it. So now, you can earn 1 apple for every 50 waves you defeat, at the same time, you can earn 2 apples for beating your own high score! With that being said, Endless Mode now records your High Score and saves it, so you can always challenge yourself to do better! (and be rewarded with apples for it too!)

Endless mode has also had some other changes. There are now random elements in play including, Spawning Jellies, Tree Bases, level layout, enemy waves and more! adding soo many more possibilities to the endless mode.

Of course, it's not just the Endless Mode that has had work done. 

[h2]Health Bars[/h2]

The Health Bars that were added in, as a suggestion from current players, have now had a new look added to them! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/23b41f14cf89712c16e3b79ca64e61490364ae66.png[/img]

[h2]New Upgrade Icon placement![/h2]

As was suggested by [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCQ28dDej_hJhNJ1it4WnAdw]ValdarakGaming[/url], the upgrade icon now appears on the tree/tower you have selected when an upgrade is possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/5ca4698838d402e55a206bc9111be2df1bfae24c.png[/img]

[h2]Balances/Bug Fixes[/h2]

Level 7 has had some extra Jelly Beans thrown into the Scenario, this is to allow a bit more time before the Gummy Bears and make the level a little easier. There was also a bug where the health bar wasn't displaying the health correctly, this has now been fixed!

notes.title: Version 0.4.5!
notes.notes:
A new update is here! This update brings bug fixes, health bars and tower balances! So, let's go into this a little more!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

A few bugs were reported which have now been fixed. Namely, the "Jelly Bro" and "Fruit Salad" achievement can now be attained without issue. Bug that prevented purchases unless you had MORE apples than required is now fixed. Bug with the UI displaying incorrect tower info, now fixed.

[h1]Health Bars[/h1]

Players suggested that they would like to see enemy health bars. These have now been implemented, as soon as an enemy is damaged a health bar appears above them. Green is full health and it transitions to red to show damage.

[h1]Tower/Tree Balances[/h1]

The Peashooters have had their upgrade price increased, as well as this, their range has been reduced. 

The Cherry Bomb upgrade from Miss Applebee is now an increase of 5 damage to each level, rather than 1. 

Thanks again everyone for the amazing feedback and bug reporting over on the Discord Server. If you see or think of anything else, let me know! 

Kind Regards

Michael

notes.title: Version 0.4.4!
notes.notes:
A new update is here! This update brings, more achievements! We now have 15 Steam Achievements added to Defend from Candyland! Can you get them all? 

Can you think of other achievements you would like to see within the game? If so, let us know! 

The new achievements entering the game with this update are (There will be more achievements added later): 

An Apple a day
Gain 7 apples!

Orchward
Gain 100 apples!

Appleragous!
Gain 300 apples!

Heres to you Miss Applebee!
Make a purchase from Miss Applebee's shop!

Candylicious!
Complete level 50!

Bananarama
Finish the level with at least 5 banana towers

Please with a cherry on top
Finish the level with at least 5 cherry towers

Carrot Top
Finish a level with at least 5 carrot fields

Fruit Salad
Complete a level using all basic trees

Are you Jelly Bro?
Kill 100 Jellybeans!

Gummy Bear Picnic
Kill 100 Gummy Bears!

Candy Crushed
Kill 500 Candies!

Try to get them all!

Another day another update! 

This is a small update adding in more HotKeys, to allow for easier controls. As well as this, the 'How To' menu has been made accessible from within the levels now and has a new layout! The options menu has also been changed, now with 2 sections. Sound/Graphics where you can access all of your sound options as well as screen dimension options. The other section is controls, where you have access to view/change all of the Hotkey shortcuts for the game! 

Endless mode has had the spawning jelly and tree bases moved to allow more room/flexibility when building your mazes! 

Keep on with the suggestions, so that I can carry on making changes to this game for you, the players!

notes.title: Version 1.4.2
notes.notes: Version 1.4.2 is out now! Added in 3 Achievements to earn. New controls added, mouse wheel control and HotKeys for making tower selection easier! The 'How To' pages have been re-designed to make them easier to read. The 'Home' button now provides a warning message before exiting the level too!

notes.title: Version 0.4.1
notes.notes:
Here we have a large update introducing an in-game shop, only asking for in-game currency, to give you more to use to Defend from Candyland!

So, let's see whats in this new update!

[b]Miss Applebee[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/8ceaa91b70ea386cacd1cf35ffe8cc6598ca2e2b.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/8ceaa91b70ea386cacd1cf35ffe8cc6598ca2e2b.gif[/img][/url]

Miss Applebee runs the new store that has been added to Defend from Candyland! Those Apples you have been collecting by defending from the onslaught of candy, use those to purchase upgrades for your existing trees. You can improve the damage of the trees you have or the slow effect of the bannana trees. As well as this, there are new trees that you can purchase to help you in your heroic fight against Candyland!

[b]Boreal Tree[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/6d214aa4b82c8fe0f5c9e2de477d0c5936028c83.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/6d214aa4b82c8fe0f5c9e2de477d0c5936028c83.png[/img][/url]

This is the Boreal Tree. It creates an area of cold designed to slow down all candies that try to pass through the snow. This will effect all of the candies within its range at the same time! 

[b]Pollen Trap[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/ee061f50cbef4803b686680a213845b78b655a78.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/ee061f50cbef4803b686680a213845b78b655a78.png[/img][/url]

This is the Pollen Trap. Another tree that effects all the candies within its range at the same time. The high pollen count that this tree gives off causes all the sweets, except one, to stop and sneeze! Delaying the sweets some more! 

Do you have an idea for a type of tree you would like to see added? Let us know over on [url=https://discord.com/invite/8XWRh2VqPq]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Music and Tower Update!
notes.notes:
After receiving feedback from multiple sources about the music, the amazing Arman Mkhitaryan of https://armanmkhitarian.weebly.com/ has made some new music for us. This replaces the previous menu music and game play music. Let us know what you think of this new music! 

As well as this, there was feedback about the towers stats not being quite balanced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/5aec133d5dd3151351a4face3e2c49b9a5d3bbe8.png[/img]
Peashooter towers  have had their range, power and speed reduced! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/3c252c4414cba611a79fc0c6b3bc9adb7cd98ae4.png[/img]

Cherry Bomb towers have had their power and range increased. Their speed and cost however have been reduced. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/9f41312e36f02b2a2a1954b0382469fcecafb4b4.png[/img]

Anti Air Carrot Fields have had their attack increased as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/a82b2566d7d3f3c303937ad4a7d03c7c0114b7df.png[/img]

Links to our social media platforms and Discord have been added to the menu. This is to allow you easier access to provide feedback to us and ask any questions, as well as you to follow us and see what else is coming for Defend from Candyland! and any future games! 


A new Shop button has been added to the menu, this is because we are currently working on adding a shop to Defend from Candyland! This shop will accept the Apples you earn for completing the levels to award you pemenent benefits. Have any ideas of something you would like to see sold in the shop? Let us know!
